trans-unit.source: I'm searching for the meaning of data within a specific business context
Click the button below to see a list of all data domains.
I'm exploring the meaning of data in a business context
Represents the meaning and ownership of an atomic data point that is part of a specific data entity.
Represents departments, business units and process owners accountable for data due to their accountability in the organization.
Represents the meaning and ownership of business process data artifacts that are used in a specific data domain.
The business part of the data governance model captures data semantics and ownership for the following types of entities:

Welcome to Aurelius Atlas! We would like to help you get started. Please pick your topic of interest below.
I'm searching for the data governance responsibilities of a specific person
Click the button below to see a list of all people with data governance responsibilities.
I'm exploring who has data governance responsibilities within my organization
Responsible for defining data entities within his or her data domain and the effectiveness of related control measures.
Responsible for the implementation of data management controls and related initiatives.
The data governance model captures various kinds of organizational roles with regards to data governance:
Accountable for the implementation of data management within a data domain.
Search for the name or email address of the person you are looking for.
I'm searching for which data is stored on a specific technical environment
Search for keywords related to the system, collection or dataset that you are looking for.
I'm exploring the technical environments on which data is stored
Represents a set of datasets, e.g. a database which usually contains multiple tables.
Represents a set of data fields. The most common example of a dataset is a table.

The technical part of the data governance model captures the technical implementation of data, such as where data is stored and the level of data quality.
The technical data governance model consists of the following types of entities:
The definition of the entity type
Represents a single, indivisible unit of data. The most common example of a field is a column in a table.
The icon representing the entity type
Represents the computing environment on which many data collections can be stored and application processes are run.
The name of the entity type
